# Customer Success Skills

> 30 open-source Agent Skills for customer success and retention in B2B SaaS. Churn
> prediction, renewal forecasting, QBR preparation, expansion discovery, escalation
> management, voice of customer, board reporting and CS operations. Works with Claude Code,
> Claude, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot and any agent supporting the Agent Skills
> standard. MIT licensed.

Every skill is built on a shared evidence standard: each number carries its source and date,
gaps are printed as `UNKNOWN — requires X` rather than filled with plausible values, and no
probability is stated without a cited backtest. Built and maintained by GainTrace.

## Documentation site

- [https://gaintrace.github.io/customer-success-skills/](https://gaintrace.github.io/customer-success-skills/): every skill as a browsable page. Each page serves the SKILL.md verbatim at
  `/skills/<name>.md`, and the site's own index is at `https://gaintrace.github.io/customer-success-skills/llms.txt`.

## Install

```
npx skills add gaintrace/customer-success-skills

# or, in Claude Code:
/plugin marketplace add gaintrace/customer-success-skills
/plugin install customer-success@customer-success-skills
```

## Standards

- [The Skill Standard](https://github.com/gaintrace/customer-success-skills/blob/main/docs/SKILL-STANDARD.md): the binding authoring contract
- [The Evidence Standard](https://github.com/gaintrace/customer-success-skills/blob/main/skills/cs-context/references/evidence-standard.md): provenance, evidence tiers, confidence criteria, the Coverage Ledger
- [The Operating Rules](https://github.com/gaintrace/customer-success-skills/blob/main/skills/cs-context/references/operating-rules.md): 24 named rules with the revenue consequence of breaking each
- [Practitioner Craft](https://github.com/gaintrace/customer-success-skills/blob/main/skills/cs-context/references/practitioner-craft.md): tacit CS craft implemented as structural mechanisms
- [Business Model Profiles](https://github.com/gaintrace/customer-success-skills/blob/main/skills/cs-context/references/business-model-profiles.md): what changes across PLG, consumption, seat-based, regulated and channel models
- [The Signal Library](https://github.com/gaintrace/customer-success-skills/blob/main/skills/cs-context/references/signal-library.md): the churn signal taxonomy with source, field, threshold and lead time
- [The Metric Dictionary](https://github.com/gaintrace/customer-success-skills/blob/main/skills/cs-context/references/metric-dictionary.md): every CS metric with its formula, edge cases and sourced benchmarks
- [Triggering](https://github.com/gaintrace/customer-success-skills/blob/main/docs/TRIGGERING.md): how skills are matched to prompts, and the routing test
- [Worked Example](https://github.com/gaintrace/customer-success-skills/blob/main/docs/worked-example.md): a complete churn risk assessment, annotated
